_doc: The README challenge sentences. Each item names a torture_he.json item by id; the sentence (field named by source) and the intended meaning (gold_<target>) are read from that golden, so the README, the tests and the golden share one source. homographs gives the intended sense of each ambiguous word as reading (source-language surface) and gloss (target-language surface) on the demo frames; demo_output is the exact demo-provider output. Both are hand-set for the demo frames and are not an accuracy result.
